free_tier_limits: Free API accounts are limited to qualifying open-data projects/products released under share-alike attribution terms. The default allowance is 50 requests/day and 200 requests/month; actual limits vary by account type and plan.
rate_limits: Default quota: 50 requests/day and 200 requests/month. Actual limits depend on account type and plan; rate-limited requests receive HTTP 403.
resolution_notes: docs_url: Corrected the underscore to the live official hyphenated URL: https://api.opencorporates.com/documentation/API-Reference. free_tier_limits: Official API Reference states free accounts are for qualifying share-alike open-data projects and gives default limits of 200/month and 50/day: https://api.opencorporates.com/documentation/API-Reference. rate_limits: The same reference publishes those default quotas, says limits vary by account and plan, and identifies HTTP 403 for rate limiting.
